svg.title: Find the MAC address in startup logs
svg.desc: Copy the STA address to identify this Wi-Fi device. softAP identifies the provisioning hotspot, not the STA. Addresses are fictional examples.

g.text: Find the MAC address in startup logs
Example values · Normal boot · 115200 / 8N1 · Text mode
Copy the STA address to identify this Wi-Fi device
softAP identifies the provisioning hotspot, not the STA
Open the serial port, then press RESET/EN; avoid download mode
